ranked.headline: Robust biomedical image representations under modality, cohort, and species shift
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add auxiliary signals like negative controls and organ priors to constrain image representations.

ranked.headline: Graph and foundation models integrate spatial, single-cell, and histology omics data
ranked.summary: Recent work applies graph, contrastive, and foundation-model architectures to integrate heterogeneous omics with histology and spatial data.

ranked.headline: Methods infer cell and niche biology from single-cell and spatial transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers extend single-cell and spatial inference to regulatory dynamics, denoising, copy number, and cell-cell communication.

ranked.headline: Language models and generative design now target protein, RNA and DNA function directly
ranked.summary: Learned sequence models now generate molecular designs and quantify selection state, moving beyond predefined-label prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational inference links microbial genomes to host, disease, and probiotic outcomes
ranked.summary: Expanded metagenome and genome collections now allow computational inference of microbial traits tied to host and clinical features.

ranked.headline: Haplotype, graph, and dosage-aware methods are refining human genomic variant detection
ranked.summary: Complete and phased genomes plus graph-based and dosage-aware callers are reshaping how structural and somatic variants are detected.

ranked.headline: Cross-region alignment profiles test limits of normative models of brain organization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test model-brain correspondence beyond static similarity, probing cross-region profiles, criticality hierarchy, and lifespan cortical change.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and new methods refine inference of selection in human genomes
ranked.summary: Simulation and benchmark evaluations now test inference tools for selection and imputation across ancient and modern human genomes.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies reveal repeat-driven size and lineage-specific gene loss
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies for non-model taxa now enable comparative tests of genome expansion, duplication history and gene family evolution.

ranked.headline: Learned models guide iterative search for synthesizable, multi-objective drug-like molecules
ranked.summary: Three 2026 papers pair transformers, GFlowNets, reinforcement learning, and LLM reasoning with QSAR or Bayesian search for molecule design.

ranked.headline: Perturbation-prediction models are being tested against rigorous baselines and benchmarks
ranked.summary: Perturbation-response data now anchor virtual cell models, prompting new scrutiny of whether benchmark gains reflect scientific value.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose accuracy and fragility limits in AlphaFold-family structure predictions
ranked.summary: Preprints now benchmark AlphaFold-family and binding free energy methods against explicit interface and energetic criteria.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models advance genome annotation, read classification and proteomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair transformer and variational models with benchmarks against established tools for genomic and proteomic data.

ranked.headline: Measuring genomic method error against controlled, reproducible reference conditions
ranked.summary: Recent work quantifies error directly in copy number calls, simulated VCFs and polygenic scores rather than assuming it.

ranked.headline: Hybrid and physics-based docking methods extend to protein interfaces and hotspots
ranked.summary: Docking and interface modelling tools are being upgraded with MD-derived pharmacophores, coarse-grained sampling, and hybrid scoring.

ranked.headline: Language models and graph transformers are being applied to genome and gene regulation
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair genomic language models and transformers with regulatory network and single-cell analysis, alongside explanation studies.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict RNA-binding residues, lncRNAs, and miRNA disease links
ranked.summary: Recent models score RNA-protein binding and candidate regulatory genes from sequence, expression, and multi-omics inputs across species and cancers.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and corrections for transcriptome, single-cell, and RNA-seq analysis methods
ranked.summary: Recent items address evaluation ground truth, RNA degradation bias, and data leakage in transcriptomic analysis pipelines.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve ion selectivity, pore block, and ceramide-altered VDAC tilt
ranked.summary: Coarse-grain and all-atom MD distinguish permeation, block, and lipid-modulated states across three membrane protein systems.

ranked.headline: LLM agents orchestrate ML pipelines for bioactivity, interaction and metabolite analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair LLM agents with containerised tools and learned models for autonomous biomedical workflows, with explicit evidence grounding.

ranked.headline: Stochastic and spatial models link regulatory rules to multicellular organization
ranked.summary: Explicit dynamical and spatial simulations now test how noise and minimal rules generate robust regulatory and multicellular organization.

ranked.headline: Rare variants, functional annotations and environment extend genomic prediction accuracy
ranked.summary: Published and preprint work now adds rare variants, functional annotation and environmental covariates to polygenic and genomic prediction models.

ranked.headline: Transcriptome-pretrained molecular embeddings combined with protein and graph encoders
ranked.summary: Cellular transcriptional profiles and cross-modal encoder fusion are now supplying supervision beyond molecular structure for drug discovery models.

ranked.headline: AlphaFold-based structural modeling informs variant effect and interaction screening
ranked.summary: UshEffect-3D reclassifies 981 of 2,639 USH2A ClinVar VUS as likely pathogenic, while AlphaFold3 pipelines scale to host-pathogen interaction screening.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models guide biomolecular sequence design and interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend structure-conditioned modeling from protein and regulatory sequences to multimodal RNA and protein foundation models.

ranked.headline: Computational structure and network methods prioritize drug targets and binders
ranked.summary: Predicted complex structures, pKa calculations, and consensus ML now enable in silico prioritization of binders, inhibitors, and pH-sensitive proteins.

ranked.headline: Microbial genomics tools for decontamination, profiling, and community design
ranked.summary: Preprints and a 2026 benchmark add control-free decontamination, genome-resolved classification, and standardized community design to profiler evaluation.

ranked.headline: Chromatin position, nucleosome state and 3D contacts shape regulatory element output
ranked.summary: Long-read footprints, Hi-C/Micro-C contact maps and integration-site screens now resolve regulatory activity within its genomic context.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale and probabilistic models infer bacterial metabolic capacity from genomes
ranked.summary: Two preprints and a published study couple genome-scale or coarse-grained models with bacterial metabolic phenotypes across media, allocation states, and genomes.

ranked.headline: Dynamical and geometric constraints sharpen noninvasive models of human brain activity
ranked.summary: Preprints now apply recurrent, geometric and variational generative models to EEG and MEG to recover whole-brain dynamics and microstates.

ranked.headline: Models link adhesion, phenotype switching and drug effects to tissue organization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply ODE, traveling-wave and spatial multi-patch models to quantify how adhesion, phenotype and drug effects govern cell organization.

ranked.headline: Models identify persistence drivers in plant disease, dispersal, and pest control
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply mechanistic transmission and dispersal models to persistence and control questions.

ranked.headline: Shiny-based tools now map spatial ECM expression and spatial metabolomics interactively
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool offer code-free interactive analysis of spatial and multicohort imaging datasets.

ranked.headline: Stochastic models validated against gait, neuronal, and calcium dynamics data
ranked.summary: Model comparison on gait, neuron, and calcium data tests whether stochastic models capture long memory, transitions, and state structure.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve membrane-coupled conformational dynamics in three protein systems
ranked.summary: Atomistic and Markov-based simulations now resolve membrane-associated conformational states and oligomerization pathways in recent published studies.

ranked.headline: Graph, ODE and mediation models integrate proteomic and transcriptomic patient data
ranked.summary: Proteogenomic datasets from CPTAC and TCGA now support graph, mediation and digital-twin models linking multi-omic layers to outcomes.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models and continual training for epitope and TCR-peptide binding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published B-cell epitope predictor pair 3D structure inputs with learned residue representations for immune recognition.

ranked.headline: Software choice and auditing shape proteomics DIA and DDA identification
ranked.summary: Recent tools target auditing and accessibility of omics software output, with DIA-NN EasyFilter assessing DIA-NN PARQUET results without coding.
